# genesyscloud_workforcemanagement_businessunits_timeoffplan (Resource)

<!-- This document is automatically generated. Do not edit manually. Make changes to the schema, examples, or apis.md files in examples/resources/ and run 'make docs' to regenerate. -->

Genesys Cloud workforce management business unit time off plan, which sets the activity codes agents can request time off with and how those requests are approved.

## API Usage

The following Genesys Cloud APIs are used by this resource. Ensure your OAuth Client has been granted the necessary scopes and permissions to perform these operations:

* [GET /api/v2/workforcemanagement/businessunits](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-workforcemanagement-businessunits)
* [GET /api/v2/workforcemanagement/businessunits/{businessUnitId}/timeoffplans](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-workforcemanagement-businessunits--businessUnitId--timeoffplans)
* [POST /api/v2/workforcemanagement/businessunits/{businessUnitId}/timeoffplans](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#post-api-v2-workforcemanagement-businessunits--businessUnitId--timeoffplans)
* [DELETE /api/v2/workforcemanagement/businessunits/{businessUnitId}/timeoffplans/{timeOffPlanId}](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#delete-api-v2-workforcemanagement-businessunits--businessUnitId--timeoffplans--timeOffPlanId-)
* [GET /api/v2/workforcemanagement/businessunits/{businessUnitId}/timeoffplans/{timeOffPlanId}](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#get-api-v2-workforcemanagement-businessunits--businessUnitId--timeoffplans--timeOffPlanId-)
* [PATCH /api/v2/workforcemanagement/businessunits/{businessUnitId}/timeoffplans/{timeOffPlanId}](https://developer.genesys.cloud/devapps/api-explorer#patch-api-v2-workforcemanagement-businessunits--businessUnitId--timeoffplans--timeOffPlanId-)

## Permissions and Scopes

The following permissions are required to use this resource:

* `wfm:timeOffPlan:add`
* `wfm:timeOffPlan:delete`
* `wfm:timeOffPlan:edit`
* `wfm:timeOffPlan:view`

The following OAuth scopes are required to use this resource:

* `workforce-management`
* `workforce-management:readonly`


## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "genesyscloud_workforcemanagement_businessunits_timeoffplan" "vacation" {
  business_unit_id = genesyscloud_workforcemanagement_businessunits.example_with_settings.id
  name             = "Vacation"
  enabled          = true

  activity_code_ids = [genesyscloud_workforcemanagement_businessunits_activitycode.team_meeting.id]

  # Checking limits needs the plan to count against them, and every management unit it applies to needs a time off limit first
  auto_approval_rule            = "CheckLimits"
  count_against_time_off_limits = true

  days_before_start_to_expire_from_waitlist = 7
  auto_publish_approved_time_off_requests   = true

  override_dates {
    date = "2026-12-25"
    type = "Blocked"
  }

  business_unit_association {
    management_unit_ids = [genesyscloud_workforcemanagement_managementunits.contact_center.id]
  }

  depends_on = [genesyscloud_workforcemanagement_businessunits_timeofflimit.contact_center]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `business_unit_id` (String) The id of the business unit this time off plan belongs to. Changing this attribute will cause the time off plan to be dropped and recreated.
- `name` (String) The name of the time off plan.

### Optional

- `activity_code_ids` (Set of String) The ids of the time off activity codes that are part of this time off plan. The default activity codes have the id of their category.
- `auto_approval_rule` (String) The rule for approving time off requests automatically. Genesys Cloud uses Never by default. Valid values: Never, Always, CheckLimits, CheckActivityCodes, CheckLimitsAndActivityCodes. The rules that check limits need count_against_time_off_limits to be true, and the rules that check activity codes need restricted_activity_code_ids.
- `auto_publish_approved_time_off_requests` (Boolean) Whether newly approved time off requests with activity codes of this time off plan are published to the schedule automatically.
- `business_unit_association` (Block List, Max: 1) Makes the time off plan belong to the business unit, and applies it to the listed management units or staffing groups. Exactly one of business_unit_association and management_unit_association is required. Genesys Cloud cannot change which of the two a time off plan has once it is created, so changing it will cause the time off plan to be dropped and recreated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--business_unit_association))
- `count_against_time_off_limits` (Boolean) Whether this time off plan counts against time off limits. Genesys Cloud uses false by default. Setting it to true needs every management unit or staffing group the plan applies to to already have a time off limit, so the plan has to be created after the time off limits, for example with depends_on. A time off limit that is created or deleted later is added to or removed from the plans that already exist.
- `days_before_start_to_expire_from_waitlist` (Number) The number of days before the start date of a time off request on which the request expires from the waitlist. Genesys Cloud uses 0 by default.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether agents can use this time off plan. Genesys Cloud enables a time off plan by default.
- `hris_time_off_type` (Block List, Max: 1) The time off type of the HRIS integration this time off plan is associated with. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--hris_time_off_type))
- `management_unit_association` (Block List, Max: 1) Makes the time off plan belong to a management unit. Exactly one of business_unit_association and management_unit_association is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--management_unit_association))
- `override_dates` (Block Set) Dates that are checked for conflicts with time off requests. A request that conflicts with one is not approved automatically. Each date can only be listed once, and Genesys Cloud only accepts dates in a limited window around today, which reaches only a short time into the past, so remove dates that have passed from the configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--override_dates))
- `restricted_activity_code_ids` (Set of String) The ids of the non time off activity codes to check for conflicts, at most 50. They are required when the auto approval rule checks activity codes, and not allowed otherwise. A request is not approved automatically when one of these activity codes is scheduled during the time off.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `time_off_limit_ids` (Set of String) The ids of the time off limits this time off plan counts against.

### Nested Schema for `management_unit_association`

Required:

- `management_unit_id` (String) The id of the management unit the time off plan belongs to. Changing it will cause the time off plan to be dropped and recreated.

Optional:

- `staffing_group_ids` (Set of String) The ids of the staffing groups of the management unit the time off plan applies to. When there are none, the plan applies to the management unit.


<a id="nestedblock--override_dates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `override_dates`

Required:

- `date` (String) The date, in the format yyyy-MM-dd and interpreted in the time zone of the business unit.
- `type` (String) What happens to a time off request that conflicts with the date. Valid values: Blocked, ManualReview.
